issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

enabled.description: Indicates if the C3 AI assistant feature is enabled.

requestTimeout.description: Default timeout in seconds of all AiAssistant requests

feedbackEnabled.description:
Indicates if the C3 AI assistant feedback service is enabled.
If feedback is disabled, the feedback capabilities of the UI should be removed.

chatHistoryLimit.description:
The maximum number of {@link AiAssistant.QAPair}s to pass to {@link AiAssistant#ask}
and persist in the {@link AiAssistant.FeedbackContext#chatHistory}.

middlewareProxyName.description: The proxy name for the middleware to be used for the C3 AI assistant requests.

askV2MicroserviceName.description: The name of the {@link AiAssistant.Microservice} that should be used for calls to {@link AiAssistant#askV2}.

title: Configuration for the C3 AI Assistant feature in Jupyter and VS Code.
